messages:
eva: Just did a smoke bring-up of peregrine-v0 (q5) on staging and hit a cluster of locale-specific failures. Korean honorifics are being downgraded, Chinese spelled numerals are emitted as ASCII digits, and Arabic punctuation placement is wrong (comma detached/LTR side). Anyone seen these symptoms together? @li-wei @sanjay :confused:

li-wei: Can you paste the minimal curl and a small repro set? Also which tokenizer shipped in the model bundle?

eva: Minimal curl: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVAL_KEY" -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model":"peregrine-v0-q5","input":"\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ud558\uc168\uc2b5\ub2c8\ub2e4.","max_tokens":48,"temperature":0}'`
Sample outputs (staging):
- KO in: "\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ud558\uc168\uc2b5\ub2c8\ub2e4" -> out: "\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8 \ub9d0\ud588\uc5b4"  <-- honorific suffix lost
- CN in: "\u8ba2\u5355\u53f7\u4e00\u4e8c\u4e09\u56db" -> out: "\u8ba2\u5355\u53f71234"  <-- digits introduced
- AR in: "\u0645\u0631\u062d\u0628\u0627\u060c ...\u061f" -> out has comma separated to LTR side and space before comma

qa-bot: quick eval snapshot: ko-politeness BLEU -3.2; cn-numeral CER +2.4; ar-rtl-punct F1 -14%

sanjay: First-pass hypotheses: (1) tokenizer mismatch (bundle vs runtime) producing different subtokens for honorifics; (2) quant fusion for low-frequency suffix embeddings in q5 alters logits; (3) detok/normalizer change broke Arabic punctuation heuristics.

mina: FYI this bundle included tokenizer_v3.0.json but our staging image was still using tokenizer_v2.8 unless explicitly pinned. That would cause different merges. Also yesterday's detok change touched arabic_spacing_rule; could be unrelated but worth checking.

li-wei: Run a tokenization diff: `python - <<'PY'
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
new=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v3.0.json')
old=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer_v2.8.json')
text='\uc120\uc0dd\ub2d8\uaed8\uc11c \ub9d0\uc500\ud558\uc168\uc2b5\ub2c8\ub2e4.'
print('v3.0 tokens ->', new.encode(text).tokens)
print('v2.8 tokens ->', old.encode(text).tokens)
PY`
If tokens around the suffix differ we should pin the tokenizer in the model manifest immediately.

eva: Did the diff: v3.0 splits the honorific into `[stem, _suffix]` while v2.8 had it as one token. Pinned tokenizer_v3.0 in manifest and reran smoke: Korean and Chinese numeral issues resolved. Arabic punctuation still broken.

sanjay: Good narrowing. For Arabic, add `?trace=true` to the generate call and dump token traces + logits for the punctuation tokens so we can see if model logits already prefer the bad spacing or if detokenizer moves punctuation after generation.

eva: Will post trace here when ready. Plan: (A) pin tokenizer in onboarding checklist and ensure tokenizer.json SHA+vocab in bundle; (B) if Arabic logits show correct spacing, bisect detok change; (C) if logits are wrong, run quant-parity (float vs q5) on the small sample to inspect embedding/logit shifts.

mina: I'll open a PR to assert tokenizer SHA at model-load and add a smoke test for CN numerals and KO honorific preservation to the onboarding suite. Also adding detok unit cases for Arabic punctuation including mixed LTR punctuation positions.

eva: Quick follow-up (30m): with tokenizer pinned KO/CN fixed. Arabic trace shows model logits favor the token sequence with an extra space before comma (logit for \u0020+\u002c higher). That implies model learned the spacing pattern, likely introduced during recent detok/normalize pretraining data step or our detok training-cleanup. I'll run a tiny bisect on preprocessing scripts to find where that modified examples were emitted.

li-wei: If it's in pretraining corpus munging, we should add a small synthetic data correction (normalize punctuation spacing) in the preprocessing pipeline and retrain/fine-tune or apply a post-decode detok heuristic to correct punctuation placement as a stop-gap.

qa-bot: next steps saved to ticket INF-4298: pin tokenizer, add onboarding asserts, add AR detok test, run quant-parity on q5 if logits remain suspicious.

eva: Thanks all, will paste the ?trace=true dump for the Arabic sample into the ticket and follow up with the detok bisect results. :thumbsup:
